title: CRITICAL: ActionNewObject (0x40) wrong push order — all new Foo(args) calls broken at AVM1 runtime
description: compileNewExpr() in compiler.ts pushes className first (deepest), then nArgs, then args (args on top). But Ruffle's action_new_object() pops className first (expects it on TOP). For new Array(1,2,3) the emitted sequence is: push 'Array', push 3, push 3, push 2, push 1, ActionNewObject — Ruffle pops class-name=1 and num_args=2. The fix: push args reversed (deepest first), then push nArgs, then push className LAST (same as compileCallExpr puts the function name on top). compileRegExpLiteral() has the same bug. The comment in newexpr.test.ts:6 correctly documents the right order but the code contradicts it. No e2e oracle covers this.
